title: How to Sell An App Idea [The Ultimate Guide]

image.alt: How to Sell An App Idea [The Ultimate Guide]

body.text: You have a brilliant app idea. You want to build it and start a business around it, but you may not have the budget or the skills to do it alone. Selling the idea, or finding a partner to develop it, is one option. Here is how to approach it.
Buyers pay for evidence, not enthusiasm. Research the market, identify who the users are, and show that people want a solution like yours.
Ideas on their own are hard to protect, but you can use non-disclosure agreements when sharing details and consider trademarks for your brand. Speak to a legal adviser about what applies to you.
3. Turn the idea into something tangible

items: A short description of the problem and the solution.

body.text: Keep it short: the problem, your solution, the target market, how it makes money and what you are asking for. A prototype demo is far more persuasive than slides alone.
Look at investors, established companies in the same industry, startup studios and development partners who may take equity or a revenue share in return for building the product.
Be clear on price, ownership of intellectual property and what happens after the sale. Always put terms in writing.
The more complete and proven your idea, the more it is worth. If you need a prototype or an MVP to support your pitch, our team can help you build it.
